name: magus
description: magus in Claude Code: health of the binary, guard and server; a pane of jobs, runs and agents; prompt-cache expiry, price-step, subagent and budget cost gates

cacheGate.title: Cache expiry gate
cacheGate.description: What happens when you submit after the prompt cache expired: off, warn (a toast), or confirm (holds the prompt once; submit again to send).

gateMinTokens.title: Gate threshold (tokens)
gateMinTokens.description: Warn or hold only when the context the next prompt re-sends is at least this large.

cacheTtl.title: Prompt-cache TTL
cacheTtl.description: One of auto, 5m or 1h. auto uses what Claude Code reports or what the mod observes, assuming 5m until then.

priceStepGate.title: Price step gate
priceStepGate.description: What happens when the context the next prompt re-sends is at or near a model's prompt-size price step, past which every request costs more: off, warn (a toast), or confirm (holds the prompt once; submit again to send).

priceStepMarginTokens.title: Price step margin (tokens)
priceStepMarginTokens.description: Act on the price step gate this many tokens before the step, so there is room to run /compact.

spawnGate.title: Subagent cost gate
spawnGate.description: What happens when a subagent would run on a model whose input rate is over the cap below: off or deny (refuses the spawn and names a cheaper route).

spawnMaxInputUsdPerMTok.title: Subagent input rate cap (USD per MTok)
spawnMaxInputUsdPerMTok.description: The most a subagent's model may charge per million input tokens before the gate acts. 2 is Sonnet's rate. 0 turns it off.

sessionBudgetUsd.title: Session budget (USD)
sessionBudgetUsd.description: Act on the budget gate once the session's main and subagent spend passes this. 0 turns it off.

budgetGate.title: Session budget gate
budgetGate.description: What happens when you submit after the session's spend passed the budget: off, warn (a toast), or confirm (holds the prompt once; submit again to send).
